# cursor_organization_group (Data Source)

Looks up one Cursor Enterprise Organization Group by ID or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cursor_organization_group" "engineering" {
  name = "Engineering"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Organization group ID with the g_ prefix. Set exactly one of id or name.
- `name` (String) Exact organization group name. Set exactly one of id or name.

### Read-Only

- `member_count` (Number) Current number of group members.
- `monthly_spending_limit_dollars` (Number) Monthly spending limit in whole dollars for each group member, or null when no override is set.
